scientific_integrity.claim_type: Exact all-parameter theorem with a full symbolic spectral proof and supplementary finite-field tests
scientific_integrity.domain: Two complete graphs of orders p,q >= 3, constant positive internal conductances a,b, one positive bridge conductance t, coordinate input at each selected vertex
unproved_limits: No near-resonance control energy or conditioning estimates
No claim of publication priority beyond inspected evidence
No claim of applicability to multiple links or independently weighted internal edges
verified_steps: Four-dimensional invariant quotient and characteristic polynomial
Simple real quotient spectrum and resonance evaluations
Popov–Belevitch–Hautus eigenspace injections and exact exceptional compact mode
Generating-polynomial enumeration and comparison to prior zero forcing

scientific_limitations: Exact algebraic controllability only; near-resonant energy conditioning is not bounded. The graph zero-forcing polynomial itself is acknowledged published prior work. Related indexed records could not be inspected in full and require human publication-priority checking.
title: A one-monomial controllability–zero-forcing gap on weighted clique barbells
